cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So we have an idea of what machine learning is kind of.
cues.zh: 大致知道機器學習是什麼了。

cues.en: But then there's other things, right?
cues.zh: 但還有其他名詞，對吧？

cues.en: Like A.I., artificial intelligence, data science, deep learning, neural networks.
cues.zh: 像 AI、人工智慧、資料科學、深度學習、神經網路。

cues.en: What are all those things?
cues.zh: 這些到底是什麼？

cues.en: Now let's look at machine learning and how it fits into some of the other words you may have heard.
cues.zh: 看看機器學習與其他聽過的名詞有什麼關係。

cues.en: Now you have to keep this diagram in mind.
cues.zh: 請記住這張圖。

cues.en: You see, it all starts with A.I. or artificial intelligence, which simply means a human intelligence exhibited by machines.
cues.zh: 一切從 AI，也就是人工智慧開始，簡單說，就是機器展現人類智慧。

cues.en: An AI is a machine that acts like a human.
cues.zh: AI 是行為像人類的機器。

cues.en: And currently in our industry, we have something called narrow A.I. that is, machines can be just as good or even better than humans at specific tasks.
cues.zh: 課程當時的產業有狹義 AI，也就是機器在特定工作上，可以與人類一樣好，甚至更好。

cues.en: For example, detecting heart disease from images or at a game of go or chess or Starcraft and other
cues.zh: 例如從影像偵測心臟病、下圍棋、西洋棋、玩《星海爭霸》等，

cues.en: video games.
cues.zh: 電玩。

cues.en: But each A.I. is only good at one task.
cues.zh: 但每個 AI 只擅長一項工作。

cues.en: Narrow A.I. that we currently have simply means those machines can only do one thing really well.
cues.zh: 目前所說的狹義 AI，意思是機器只能把一件事做得很好。

cues.en: They can't be like humans and have multiple abilities.
cues.zh: 無法像人類一樣具備多種能力。

cues.en: That's called General A.I. and it's something that we're very, very far away from now.
cues.zh: 那稱為通用 AI，講者認為距離實現仍很遙遠。

cues.en: Machine learning is a subset of AI, and machine learning is an approach to try and achieve artificial
cues.zh: 機器學習是 AI 的子領域，透過能從一組資料找出模式的系統，嘗試實現人工，

cues.en: intelligence through systems that can find patterns in a set of data.
cues.zh: 智慧。

cues.en: And actually, Stanford University describes machine learning as the science of getting computers to act without being explicitly programmed.
cues.zh: 史丹佛大學將機器學習描述為，讓電腦在沒有明確編寫程式指令的情況下行動的科學。

cues.en: That is, getting machines to do things without us specifically saying, do this, then do that.
cues.zh: 也就是不用明確告訴機器「先這樣、再那樣」，就能讓它做事。

cues.en: If, then if this, if this, then that.
cues.zh: 不用一直寫「如果這樣，那就那樣」。

cues.en: And don't worry, we'll explain that more throughout the section.
cues.zh: 別擔心，這一章會進一步說明。

cues.en: Now, you may have also heard of deep learning and deep learning or deep neural networks is just one
cues.zh: 你也可能聽過深度學習；深度學習或深度神經網路，只是，

cues.en: of the techniques for implementing machine learning.
cues.zh: 實作機器學習的其中一種技術。

cues.en: For now, you can just think of it as a type of algorithm.
cues.zh: 目前可以先想成一種演算法。

cues.en: But then we have this other thing that we've heard of, right, that's also very popular, that is data science.
cues.zh: 還有另一個很熱門的名詞，就是資料科學。

cues.en: And often the role of a data science and machine learning expert are quite overlapping and most job
cues.zh: 資料科學與機器學習專家的工作常高度重疊，多數職缺，

cues.en: descriptions actually don't even have a clear distinction between what is a machine learning expert and a data science expert.
cues.zh: 其實沒有清楚區分機器學習專家與資料科學專家。

cues.en: The field of data science simply means analyzing data, looking at data, and then doing something with it, usually some sort of a business goal.
cues.zh: 資料科學簡單說，就是分析、查看資料，再加以運用，通常為了達成某種商業目標。

cues.en: So when we talk about machine learning, there's a lot of overlap with data science, and that's why this course is called machine learning and data science.
cues.zh: 所以機器學習與資料科學重疊很多，這也是課程叫做機器學習與資料科學的原因。

cues.en: If you are a data scientist, you need to know machine learning.
cues.zh: 資料科學家需要懂機器學習。

cues.en: If you are a machine learning expert, you need to know data science.
cues.zh: 機器學習專家需要懂資料科學。

cues.en: So throughout the next couple of videos, we're going to be talking about both of these topics because both of them relate and overlap and you can't do one without the other because you need to be able to
cues.zh: 接下來幾支影片會同時談兩個主題，因為彼此相關、互有重疊，不能完全分開；做這些事，都需要，

cues.en: understand data and work with data to do any of these things.
cues.zh: 理解並處理資料。

cues.en: That's why when we talk about careers, often things like machine learning, data scientist, data analyst, they're all similar because they all work with data.
cues.zh: 所以談到職涯，機器學習、資料科學家、資料分析師往往很相似，因為都處理資料。

cues.en: And from that data they want to derive some sort of action for their business, for the company or for their users.
cues.zh: 希望從資料，為企業、公司或使用者找出可以採取的行動。

cues.en: Now, in this course, we're really focusing on the application side of things.
cues.zh: 這門課聚焦在應用。

cues.en: That is the day to day use of machine learning and data science.
cues.zh: 也就是日常如何使用機器學習與資料科學。

cues.en: We won't focus on theoretical academic research, which means you won't need a PhD or be super smart mathematician or statistician to do this course.
cues.zh: 不聚焦理論學術研究，所以不需要博士學位，也不用是很厲害的數學家或統計學家。

cues.en: The focus is on using machine learning and data science to be productive and to get job ready, because that's what companies want right now.
cues.zh: 重點是運用機器學習與資料科學提高生產力，做好就業準備，因為企業需要這些能力。

cues.en: Now, when Daniel starts introducing data science and machine learning, he'll combine these two into one and move this machine learning circle inside of data science.
cues.zh: Daniel 開始介紹資料科學與機器學習時，會把兩者合起來，將機器學習的圓圈放到資料科學裡。

cues.en: That's because the goal of the course is to encompass this entire data science field and teach the machine learning aspects within data science.
cues.zh: 因為目標是涵蓋整個資料科學領域，並教其中的機器學習。

cues.en: By the way, you might be wondering, Hey, what about this whole data engineering thing that I've heard about?
cues.zh: 順帶一提，你也許會問，聽過的資料工程又是什麼？

cues.en: That's another term, isn't it?
cues.zh: 這是另一個名詞，對吧？

cues.en: What about that?
cues.zh: 它呢？

cues.en: Talk about that, Andre.
cues.zh: Andrei，說明一下。

cues.en: Well, you know what?
cues.zh: 你知道嗎？

cues.en: We have a whole section on it later on in the course.
cues.zh: 課程後面有一整章。

cues.en: So for now, pretend like it doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 所以目前先假裝它不存在。

cues.en: We'll get to it, I promise.
cues.zh: 我保證之後會介紹。

cues.en: So now that we have an idea of what these big words are, let's have some fun in the next video.
cues.zh: 知道這些熱門名詞大致是什麼後，下一支影片來做些有趣的事。
